meta.name: cellprofiler
meta.description: Runs reproducible CellProfiler microscopy pipelines for nuclear segmentation, cell counts, and per-object fluorescence measurements. Supports image/channel manifests, headless batch execution, segmentation overlays, and measurement QC for 2D fluorescence assays.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把显微图像批量跑成细胞核分割、细胞计数和荧光定量结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有大量 2D 荧光显微图像,要重复做核分割与定量
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you process batches of 2D fluorescence images needing repeatable segmentation and counts

howto.what: Claude 会按你给的图像清单调用 CellProfiler,做细胞核分割、计数和逐核荧光测量,产出 Image.csv、Nuclei.csv、核边界叠加图和质检文件 assay_qc.json。
howto.when: 当你需要可重复的 CellProfiler 管线、细胞核计数或批量显微荧光测量时触发。输入须是单张 2D 灰度 TIFF 核通道,RGB、z-stack、浮点图会被拒绝。

say.text: 帮我准备 images.csv 并跑细胞核计数,结果放到 results
检查这批图的计数和强度,有没有饱和或零计数的场
看一下分割叠加图,有没有漏检、粘连或贴边的核
say.note: 叠加图存为 *_nuclei.png,绿线是核边界

howto.what_en: Claude runs CellProfiler on your image manifest to segment and count nuclei and measure per-nucleus fluorescence, producing Image.csv, Nuclei.csv, overlay images and assay_qc.json.
howto.when_en: For repeatable CellProfiler pipelines, nuclear counts or batch microscopy measurements. Input must be a single 2D grayscale TIFF nuclear channel; RGB, z-stacks or floats are rejected.

say_en.text: Prepare images.csv and run nuclear counts into results
say_en.note: Runs prepare, then headless CellProfiler with -c -r

say_en.text: Check this batch for saturated or zero-count fields
say_en.note: summarize inspects the CSV counts and intensities

say_en.text: Show the segmentation overlays for missed or merged nuclei
